name: epona
author: Hybrasyl Maintainers <hybrasyl@eris.co>
_dependenciesNote: electron-builder copies EVERY `dependencies` entry into app.asar verbatim.
Only main and preload are externalized (externalizeDepsPlugin); the renderer
config has none, so vite already bundles every UI library into out/renderer.
Anything renderer-only listed here therefore ships TWICE. Keep this list to
what main/preload actually require at run time.
da-win32 is easy to get wrong: it is loaded via createRequire(), not a static
import, AND it is rollup-external, so it is NOT bundled and must be present in
node_modules at run time. A grep for import/require will not find it.
_overridesNote: TWO entries, and the second is why the first is safe. Do not remove one alone.
brace-expansion <=5.0.7 carries a high-severity DoS advisory (GHSA-mh99-v99m-4gvg).
It reaches us only through dev tooling -- eslint, electron-builder, @electron/rebuild
-- so nothing that ships is affected. It is an override rather than a bump because
there is nothing to bump to: the advisory range spans every major. npm's own
`audit fix --force` answer is to downgrade eslint-plugin-react to 7.22.0 and
electron-builder to 22.14.13, four majors back, to settle a DoS in a build tool.
The trap: brace-expansion 5.x CHANGED ITS EXPORT SHAPE. 1.x/2.x were
`module.exports = expand`; 5.x is `module.exports = { expand, ... }`. minimatch 3.x
does `var expand = require('brace-expansion')` and calls it, so under a bare
brace-expansion override it dies with `TypeError: expand is not a function` --
but ONLY for a pattern containing braces, because minimatch 3.x short-circuits
braceExpand for patterns without them. Our eslint config globs
`**/*.{js,jsx,mjs,cjs}`, so we hit it immediately; an app whose config happens to
use no braces passes and ships the landmine instead.
Hence the second override. eslint 9 pins @eslint/config-array 0.21.x, which bundles
minimatch 3.1.5; 0.23.x moved to minimatch ^10, which imports the NAMED export and
is compatible with brace-expansion 5.x. Overriding it fixes the root cause without
an eslint 10 major bump. Verified that eslint still genuinely lints (166 files, and
it still reports a seeded error) rather than silently matching nothing.
Drop both once eslint 10 lands here -- it depends on minimatch ^10 directly.
